title: Decision-model bake-off case
description: One generated, synthetic case for the decision-model bake-off (REQ-BEN-005, DEC-2026-10-20 D9, build prompt T4 item 9a). A case is one typed question about one input, one of the six understanding tasks of PERD §19.1 that a decision model is eligible for: intent node classification, the enumerated slots, ambiguity-flag proposals, locale and code-switching detection, answer binding, and instruction-likeness screening. `expected` is the truth by construction. `perturbations` are meaning-preserving rewrites of the input, used for the flip rate. Generated layer only: never held-out material (INV-22). Synthetic text only until each provider's data terms are reviewed (PERD R-18). The Nigerian-language phrasing is template text for measurement and has not been reviewed by native speakers. SYNTHETIC (AGENT-25).

task.description: The six tasks of PERD §19.1, in table order.

language_bucket.description: The split every metric is reported by (build prompt T4 item 9a).

context.description: Optional structured context the question needs, for example the options offered to the customer in an answer-binding case.

question.description: The typed question. A choice always offers an abstention (`none` or `other`): the harness rejects a choice without one (PERD §19.1).

expected.description: The right answer: one of `question.options`. For a yes_no question the options are yes and no.

perturbations.description: Meaning-preserving rewrites of `input.text`. The answer should not change under any of them.
